data.title: Talks between US, Iran reportedly do not include Iran's nuclear program | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: “If this stage is concluded, the nuclear issue will be one of the next items for negotiations,” Tasnim quoted Baghaei. “The rest of the discussions that are being raised now are media speculation."
